newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal buys marks around 99.68 escudos.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal buys marks around 99.68 escudos.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal bought marks at 99.68 escudos per mark to counteract the rapid appreciation of the escudo, dealers said.
"The Bank of Portugal started buying marks around 99.68 escudos," said a dealer who asked not to be identified.
Another said: "The problem facing the Bank of Portugal is not the sentiment, but the speed with which the escudo is rising, and so the central bank started buying marks."
The Bank of Portugal declined comment.
At 0935 GMT, the escudo stood at 99.74/77 per mark.
Dealers said foreign investors had been buying escudos heavily since the start of the week.
"This trend can only be stopped by the Bank of Portugal, and this is happening," said a dealer.
